PLANNING YOUR PROJECT

A few things
to know first.

Can you redesign an existing website?+

Yes. We can review your current website and propose a redesign based on your brand, content, audience and goals.

Will the website work on mobile?+

Yes. Responsive layouts form part of the website development approach, with the experience adapted for desktop, tablet and mobile screens.

How much does a website cost?+

Pricing depends on the number of pages, content needs, features and integrations. After understanding your requirements, we can discuss a suitable scope and quote.

How long does a project take?+

The timeline depends on the agreed scope and the availability of content and feedback. We discuss a project timeline once your requirements are understood.

Can you help with a domain and hosting?+

Yes. We can work with your existing setup or provide guidance on suitable domain and hosting options. Any setup requirements can be included in the agreed scope.

What should I prepare before we speak?+

A brief description of your business, your goals, any existing website or brand material, and examples of the style you like are useful starting points.
